fusions.name: Three Quick Stabs
fusions.desc: Three stabs in a blink that deal 7 damage and leave the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: From the Sleeve
fusions.desc: Flicks a hidden blade at the first enemy in its path, dealing 32 damage that ignores its armour.

fusions.name: Gone Before the Draw
fusions.desc: Veils you for 5 seconds, and you move 30% faster while it holds. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Second Cut
fusions.desc: Once every 6 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
